Women's black and white Nike Court Royale sneaker in size 8.5 Regular US. Features a leather upper, traditional lace-up closure, and a contrasting Swoosh running from heel to midfoot. Black electronics organizer bag from Jelly Comb, made of water-resistant nylon. It has two zippers, elastic loops for cables, mesh sections for USB drives, a card slot for SD/TF cards, and a pocket for a 7.9-inch tablet like an iPad mini. A detachable hand strap makes it easy to carry.

Under Armour Women's Favorite Tote 2.0 in Hushed Turquoise with Radial Turquoise accents. Measures 20.3" W x 12.6" L x 9.8" H when full, with 25 L (1,525 cubic inches) of capacity.

A modern take on the Nike Air Mariah, a shoe first released in the 1980s. It has a Flyknit upper with a sock-like fit, Zoom Air cushioning, a heel pull tab, and a rubber outsole. The construction is lightweight. SKU 918264-200-10.5.

specs.included: Hook and loop roll, push pins, instruction manual

record.description: A magnetic fiberglass door screen with 18 x 16 mesh, sized at 38" W x 81" H to fit doors up to 36" W x 80" H. Webbed edges and 6-needle-per-inch stitching add durability, with reinforced top-middle sewing. Hook-and-loop hasps on the middle and bottom help keep it from blowing away. Includes hook-and-loop roll, push pins, and instructions.

A 5 x 8 foot teal blue shaggy indoor area rug with a 1.57-inch pile. A high-density sponge middle layer adds softness and sound absorption, and anti-slip dots on the underside are meant to reduce sliding on floors. Suitable for living rooms, bedrooms, and kids' rooms.

specs.sleeve: Long sleeve with roll tab and buttons
specs.care: Machine or hand wash cold, do not bleach

record.description: Men's long-sleeve henley shirt in blue, 3XL, made from an 80% cotton, 20% polyester oxford blend. Features a mandarin collar, popover placket with chest buttons, roll-tab sleeves with buttons, and a straight-cut hem. Regular fit. Machine or hand wash cold; do not bleach. Suited to spring, summer evenings, and fall.

specs.putting surface: Approx. 2 ft x 8.5 ft inside border

record.description: A 3-foot by 10-foot golf putting training mat from JEF World of Golf, with roughly 2 by 8.5 feet of synthetic turf inside its border. It includes two holes with flags and is suitable for indoor or outdoor use. The mat has a padded rubber base.

Black 35mm F1.2 manual focus lens for APS-C mirrorless cameras with Canon EOS-M mount. Features a maximum aperture of F1.2, a crescent-shaped focus ring, multi-layer coating, and a 6-element, 5-group optical design with a copper core and aluminum shell.

specs.light modes: Flicker and steady glow, adjustable brightness

record.description: Set of two 6-inch outdoor flameless candles with a flickering moving flame, waterproof for outdoor use. Each runs on two AA batteries and is controlled by remote, with 2, 4, 6, or 8 hour timers, flicker or steady glow modes, and adjustable brightness. Made of ivory frosted plastic, 3.25 inches in diameter.

specs.item type: Long sleeve shirt or long johns

record.description: Men's thermal base layer set from STARK SOUL, available as a long sleeve shirt or long johns, in black/blue, sizes L/XL. Made from high-elastic sports fabric with double-seamless construction and intended for autumn and winter activities such as hiking, cycling, skiing, and snowboarding. The fabric is described as offering warmth, breathability, and moisture absorption.

A replacement USB charging cable for Mini S530 Bluetooth earbuds, with a 2.0mm x 12.0mm DC plug and a 30cm (11.8 in) cable. It can draw power from wall adapters, laptop USB ports, power banks, or car chargers. Not compatible with B&O Earset 2 or Blue Parrot headsets. Measure the plug before ordering.

specs.decoration: Polyester felt dog appliqué on front

record.description: The 3 Sprouts Cube Storage Box is a 13-inch cube organizer made of 100% polyester, designed to fit most cube shelving units. It has a handy tab on the front for easy pulling by children and adults, and a dog-shaped felt appliqué decorates the front. Intended for kids and toddlers.

specs.insulation: Thermal insulation liner, keeps food warm or cold
specs.cooling duration: At least 7 hours with ice cubes

record.description: Grey 15-liter insulated lunch bag for women and men with two separate layers to keep foods apart. Its seamless, leakproof liner wipes clean easily and insulates to hold temperature for at least seven hours with ice. Roomy enough for lunches, snacks, and drinks, and handy for picnics or daily carry.

specs.care: Oven, microwave, freezer and dishwasher safe

record.description: Four stoneware rice bowls from Denby's Heritage Terrace collection, in a multicolor design. Made in England and handcrafted by skilled artisans, the bowls are safe for oven, microwave, freezer, and dishwasher use.

specs.product_type: Corrugate cat scratcher and lounge chaise
specs.use: Floor scratcher, corrugate block, and lounging spot

record.description: SmartyKat Super Scratcher Chaise is a corrugated cardboard cat scratcher that doubles as a lounge. Catnip is infused between each layer, releasing scent with every scratch. The corrugate texture mimics tree bark, and the chaise shape works as a floor scratcher or a resting spot. Made in the USA.

Women's sleeveless navy midi dress in lace with a fit-and-flare silhouette. It has a contemporary fit that runs small, so the size chart should be checked. Size M corresponds to 6-8. The dress is partially lined.

L'Occitane Cherry Blossom Bath & Shower Gel comes in an 8.4 fl oz bottle. Designed for sensitive skin, it gently cleanses and leaves a delicate cherry blossom scent. Apply to wet skin, lather, and rinse for a fragranced shower.

specs.package dimensions: 3.12 in L x 3.12 in W x 5.06 in H

record.description: The WIX 57502XP is an automotive oil filter from the brand WIX, model number 57502XP, made in China. The package weighs 0.75 pounds and measures 3.12 by 3.12 by 5.06 inches.

Large nylon beach blanket sized for four to eight adults, with a sand-resistant, water-resistant surface. It folds small, weighs about 12 ounces, and comes with a storage bag. Four built-in pockets hold small essentials, and four ground stakes help it stay put in wind. Useful for beaches, picnics, camping, and as a yoga or baby play mat.

Sperry Cruise boat shoe in navy and grey, sized Big Kid 5. It has a leather-like upper, a lace-up closure for a snug fit, and a memory foam footbed. The cupsole has a rubber outsole for traction. Designed to be worn as a casual or dress-leaning shoe for kids.

The UGG Women's Classic Short Rubber Logo Fashion Boot comes in black, size 8 M US. It has a suede upper, a 17 mm UGGpure lining and insole, and a Treadlite by UGG outsole. A UGG logo is printed in rubber on the front of the shaft.

specs.material: Glossy smooth vinyl with linen lining
specs.straps: Adjustable poly-webbing neck and waist straps with long waist ties

record.description: A pink glossy vinyl apron that is waterproof and ultra lightweight. Its smooth surface wipes clean easily, and it has a linen lining on the inside. Adjustable poly-webbing neck and waist straps include long waist ties. It measures 12 inches at the neck, 22 inches along the bottom, and 29 inches tall.

Full-motion steel wall mount for TVs and monitors from 13 to 30 inches, supporting up to 33 lbs and VESA 75x75mm and 100x100mm patterns. Offers ±15° tilt, up to ±90° swivel (depending on TV size), 360° rotation, and an arm extending up to 14 inches from the wall. Includes lag screws and mounting hardware.

TIMEYARD 3-tier corner wall shelf made of lightweight paulownia wood with a dark brown distressed finish and jute rope hanging cords. Fan-shaped boards measure about 11 inches in radius and 0.7 inches thick, with a recommended load of 10 lbs per shelf. Stands about 40 inches tall and must be hung in a corner to stay level.

Hudson baby girl's cotton dresses in a blueberry pattern, sized 12-18 months. This coordinating set is made of 100% cotton, designed to feel soft and gentle on baby's skin. Suited to everyday wear, the value pack offers affordable everyday dresses.

Four Paws Wee-Wee odor control dog pads with Febreze Freshness, 50 count. Each 22" x 23" pad has a rapid-drying top layer to reduce tracking, a Wet-Lock gel core that traps liquid, and a built-in attractant meant to draw dogs to the pad. The pads are intended for dogs of all sizes and are scented to help neutralize ammonia odors.

A two-pack of collapsible wall-mounted drying racks with an ABS plastic mount and stainless steel rod, rated for up to 60 lbs. Each folds to 18 by 3 by 2 inches when closed and extends 15 inches deep when open, offering 12 inches of hanging space. Includes a mounting template, anchors for drywall and masonry, and wood screws.

A yellow nylon mesh banner, 18 by 84 inches, with black OVERSIZE LOAD lettering for vehicles hauling wide or large loads. Brass grommets allow attachment to the front or back of a vehicle, and black edge binding finishes the edges. Many states require such markings when oversize loads travel at night.

A set of 48 neon green floating golf balls for practice in water, such as pools, ponds, or water ranges. Each ball has a two-piece build, 432 dimples, a 90 compression rating, and an injection-molded Surlyn cover. A carry bag is included.

specs.faucet connection: Universal faucet adapter with Quick Connect

record.description: A white countertop dishwasher from SPT that is compact and portable, with a stainless steel interior and a rack for six place settings. It offers six wash cycles and delay start options, connects to most kitchen faucets through a universal adapter, and has an LED display with warning indicators for water supply and rinse aid.

specs.included_tools: Bain-marie, decorating stands, baking and decorating gadgets

record.description: AMAV Cake Pop Maker toy for kids aged 6 and up. The set includes a bain-marie, decorating stands, and other baking and decorating tools, plus a color-printed recipes booklet. No oven is needed, and the listing claims cake pops can be made in about 30 seconds. Food is not included.

A solid brass faucet aerator that rotates 720 degrees to direct water across a sink, with soft and strong flow modes. Its polished, electroplated finish is not prone to rust. It fits most round faucets and installs by hand in a few seconds. Air added to the stream gives a softer, less splashing flow.

Men's adidas golf shoe in grey, green and black, size 10 US. Features a regular fit, lace closure, and a mesh and synthetic upper. The midsole uses Bounce cushioning with Boost in the heel. The upper contains at least 50% recycled content, made with Primegreen materials.
Men's Stetson & Dobbs Carolina straw hat in natural, model OSCLNA-3832, size XL. Outback style with a vented crown. Listed under Clothing.

Two clear acrylic apothecary jars, 15 oz and 20 oz, with removable lids and wide mouths for storing cotton swabs, cotton balls, cotton rounds, and bath salts. The plastic resembles glass but is shatter-resistant. Suitable for bathroom vanities, kitchens, or living rooms. Brand: SheeChung.

specs.features: Kickstand, card holder slot, swivel belt clip
specs.included: 1 hybrid case, 1 tempered glass screen protector

record.description: Rose gold protective case for the Samsung Galaxy On5, with a two-layer hybrid design, brushed metal-look texture, kickstand, card holder slot, and swivel belt clip. Package includes one case and one tempered glass screen protector. Phone not included.

Electric facial hair remover for women, model Ke-208, with a 180 motor and dual stainless steel blades for the lips, cheeks, and chin. Includes one replacement head and a PTEE housing. Portable, and the maker estimates about two years of facial use.

specs.strap_length: 9.8 ft (3 m) tree straps with 18 loops each
specs.packing: Integrated stuff bag attached to hammock

record.description: Double-layer camping hammock for two, made from seamless 210T nylon taffeta with black and orange faces that can be reversed. Measures 8.9 x 4.6 ft and is rated to 880 lbs. Includes 9.8 ft tree straps with 18 loops each and two carabiner clips. Packs into an attached bag that can be hung from a backpack. Certified by German TUV.

Medium hooded reindeer costume for dogs, suited to Christmas or other winter-themed parties. It fastens with Velcro at the neck and chest. The listing gives different fit measurements in different sections, so check them against your dog's measurements before ordering.

specs.control panel: LED touch screen with 2 memory buttons and child lock

record.description: A 47 by 30 inch electric desk that adjusts from 29 to 49 inches in height and tilts from 13 to 45 degrees. Dual motors drive the lift, and an LED touch panel offers memory presets and a child lock. Two USB ports charge devices at the desk. Holds up to 165 lbs.

Wild Republic's 10-piece pirate playset includes five pirate figures, a two-piece cannon, an open treasure chest, an eye patch, and an X-marks-the-spot flag. Suited for ages 3 and up, it is made without phthalates or lead and cleans with soap and water. Good for imaginative play, dioramas, and pirate-themed party favors.

specs.cushioning: Gel pads in heel and forefoot

record.description: Sof Sole men's blue insole in size 9 to 10.5, trim-to-fit for casual and athletic shoes. It has a contoured neutral arch and gel pads in the heel and forefoot for lightweight cushioning. A Hydrologix moisture-wicking treatment is included to help keep feet dry. Suited to walking, running, cross training, and everyday wear.

specs.style: Mid-century modern accent arm lounge chair

record.description: Modway's Dock is a mid-century modern accent armchair in azure. It has a curved back, a cut-out silhouette, and a slight recline. The chair is covered in polyester fabric with subtle piped trim and sits on dark walnut stained wood legs. Dense foam padding forms the seat. It measures 28.5"L x 27.5"W x 31"H and supports up to 440 lbs.

A round, two-tier stainless steel lunch container in white, with a twist-open lid and locking clips that hold the tiers together. It is BPA free, dishwasher safe, and freezer safe, and is suited to soup and hot food. The vacuum seal is designed to help prevent leaks and spills.

specs.pattern: Printed, hand-drawn designs by HUE NYC studio

record.description: HUE women's Bermuda pajama sleep shorts in chambray blue with a printed knit fabric and a printed design. Features a relaxed fit, an elastic waistband, and a 10.5-inch inseam. The print is described as hand-drawn by the HUE NYC studio design team. Size Large.

specs.included accessories: 2 optional hand pairs, optional head, backpack, holographic wings, 2 weapons
specs.transformation: Flying mode via detachable wing gears

record.description: Bandai Tamashii Nations S.H.Figuarts Falcon action figure from Marvel's Avengers: Infinity War. The 6-inch scale figure is fully articulated and can be posed in a flying mode using detachable wing gears. Included accessories are two pairs of optional hands, an optional head, a backpack for the wings, holographic wings, and two weapons. Recommended for ages 15 and up.

Red radiator grille mesh decal sticker for the 2018 Kia Stinger, sold as a set of one. Made in Korea and new. Designed to attach to the front bumper radiator grille with adhesive double-sided tape. Described as a 3D-printed design intended to fit the grille and give it a stylized look.

Funko Pop! vinyl figure of Thor from Marvel's Avengers: Endgame, presented in a stylized design. The collectible stands 3.75 inches tall and is multicolored. It is part of a series, so fans can display it alongside other Endgame Pop! figures. The eyes and paint differences are subtle and are easiest to see outside the packaging.

Training-style sweatpants, Type F, with a My Hero Academia anime cosplay theme, made of 100% cotton. Available in XX-Large with standard US sizing, for adults and kids. Suitable for everyday wear, Halloween, themed parties, and cosplay, and a gift option for anime fans.

A 9-foot round beige patio umbrella with a 100% polyester canopy and eight ribs. It opens and closes with a hand crank, tilts by push button to adjust the angle, and includes a wind vent. The base is not included. Suited to outdoor tables, gardens, and patios.

specs.included_items: Tin planter, plant liner, 2 coconut fiber pucks, paint brush, paint strip
specs.included_accessories: Stake holders for labeling plant spots

record.description: A children's gardening kit for growing Zinnia, Marigold, and Cosmos flowers. It comes with a tin planter, coconut fiber pucks, and a six-color paint strip for decorating and mixing new shades. Stake holders help young gardeners label and organize their plantings, and easy-to-follow instructions are included.

Men's hiking shoe in walnut, size 10.5 M US, from Merrell. The upper combines performance suede leather with mesh, and the breathable mesh lining is paired with a bellows tongue of closed-cell foam that helps keep out moisture and debris. A rubber toe cap adds protection, and the outsole is a Vibram TC5+ with 5 mm lug depth.

specs.interior: fully lined with zippered organizer pockets
specs.handles: top, bottom, and side grab handles

record.description: Navy 20-inch carry-on hardside suitcase from Ben Sherman. It rolls on four multi-directional spinner wheels and has an ABS shell with corner guards. The interior is fully lined and includes zippered organizer pockets and a garment restraint panel. Top, bottom, and side grab handles aid lifting, and the telescoping trolley handle retracts and extends to 41 inches.

specs.care: Hand wash cold; do not bleach; hang or line dry
specs.suitable_for: School, office, casual, dating, beach, party

record.description: A women's lightweight open front blazer in red, size small, with a classic draped design and slip-on fit. Made of rayon with some stretch, it suits school, office, casual, dating, beach, and party occasions. Hand wash cold, do not bleach, and hang or line dry.

A 120-piece fort building kit with 75 sticks, about 15 inches long, and 45 blue and green connector balls. Rods twist into the balls to join and separate easily, and a storage bag is included. A blanket is not included. Suited to indoor or outdoor fort and tunnel building, listed for ages 3 to 7.

Rechargeable heated memory foam insoles from BIAL, offered in small, medium, and large sizes for men and women. A built-in button adjusts three heat levels and shows remaining battery. Insoles can be trimmed to fit, are washable, and come with a one-year warranty.

Jessica Simpson J5596 women's aviator sunglasses with a gold-tone metal frame and logo-stamped temples. The impact-resistant polycarbonate lenses have a gradient brown tint and a protective coating that blocks UV rays. Measurements are 60 mm lens width, 140 mm temple length, and 18 mm bridge width. Includes a soft microfiber pouch with a drawstring closure.

specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: Men's large compression pants in a 92% polyester and 8% spandex blend, with a tight, second-skin fit and a waist of 34 to 35 inches. The soft, lightweight fabric is machine washable and rated UPF 30 for sun protection. Designed for football, soccer, running, and other sports in any weather.

A men's heavyweight car coat in black, size Small, made from a thick wool blend twill that feels warm and soft. It has a button-front closure and a roomy fit through the chest and waist. It is an Amazon Essentials brand piece.

Twelve large traditional gift bows made of silver metallic foil, each about 4.5 inches across. They have a self-adhesive backing for easy application to gift wrap or packages. The bows are sold as a set of 12 and are listed as coordinating with other curly ribbon bows and wired-edge ribbon, which are sold separately.

specs.charging: QC 3.0 fast-charge USB port plus 2.4A USB port
specs.lighting: LED backlight with 7 colors and 2 modes

record.description: Orange Bluetooth FM transmitter and car radio adapter with two USB ports, one QC 3.0 fast-charge port and one 2.4A port. Compact 1.6-inch body with four buttons and an LED backlight in seven colors.

specs.design: Inverted bottle keeps jelly fresh, clean and dry
specs.dispensing: Internal jelly stirrer dispenses measured amounts
specs.compatibility: Bottle fits most standard 32 oz jelly jars

record.description: Perky-Pet Model 253 oriole jelly feeder in red, holding 32 oz of jelly. The inverted bottle is meant to keep jelly fresh, clean, and dry, and an internal stirrer dispenses measured portions. The bottle can be swapped with most standard 32 oz jelly jars, and the feeder is described as easy to clean.

King-size hotel-style sheet set from Sferra's Grande Hotel Collection, in white. Made in Italy from 100% Italian Egyptian cotton percale with a 200 thread count. Includes one flat sheet, one fitted sheet, and two pillowcases. The sheets are framed in double rows of colored satin stitching, except the fitted sheet, which has none.

specs.fitment: Car interior dome, map, trunk and cargo lights
specs.installation: Plug and play; rotate 180 degrees if not lit

record.description: Ten white 42mm festoon LED bulbs for car interiors, suited to dome, map, trunk, and cargo lights. Each bulb carries 16 SMD 3528 LEDs with a 6000K color temperature. The Millennium Marine SW-200 is a gray boat seat measuring 18 by 21 by 6 inches. It is designed to mount on most boat pedestals and weighs 8 pounds. The seat is rated for up to 400 pounds and carries a 3-year warranty.

specs.mixable: Yes, with other MANIC PANIC formulas and Pastelizer
specs.best results: Pre-lighten hair to level 8 or lighter; level 9-10 recommended
specs.color depth: Deep cool fuschia, darkest pink in line

record.description: MANIC PANIC Fuschia Shock is a deep, cool fuschia semi-permanent dye, the darkest pink in the brand's line. This ready-to-use cream needs no developer and fades over four to six weeks. It is vegan, cruelty free, and free of ammonia and parabens, and it can be mixed with other MANIC PANIC formulas.

Women's mid ankle hiking boot from Timberland in dark brown, size 5 M US. Made with a leather upper, shock-absorbing cushioning, and a rubber lug outsole for traction. The listing describes it as waterproof. Designed for outdoor trail use with a rugged, outdoor-style look.

Under Armour men's Freedom Blitzing cap in Academy Blue with red accents, sized X-Large/XX-Large. Features a Classic Fit, a pre-curved visor, and a structured, foam-padded front panel. Made with UA Microthread fabric, which dries faster and resists clinging. Part of the UA Freedom program, which commits a minimum annual donation to first responders, military, law enforcement, and veterans.
Daewoo KOR07R3ZER microwave oven in red with a 0.7 cubic foot capacity. Includes a turntable. Model KOR07R3ZER, categorized under Home & Kitchen.

specs.suitable_for: Weddings, festivals, photography, bridal and flower girl use

record.description: Handmade flower crown headband in royal blue, sold under the Love Sweety brand. It measures about 19 cm (7.48 in) in diameter and is listed as fitting most head sizes. Suitable for weddings, festivals, photo shoots, bridal wear, bridesmaids, and flower girls.

specs.features: Cup holder, speaker holders, headphone hook, cable tray

record.description: A black gaming desk with a Z-shaped metal frame and a curved, carbon-fiber-style top measuring 42.5 by 23.6 by 27.56 inches. It includes a cup holder, two speaker holders, a headphone hook, and a rear cable tray. It supports up to 280 lbs and has an extra suction foot on the legs for added stability.

specs.barrel length: Extra long, 2 inches longer than typical irons

record.description: Gold 1-inch curling iron from Hot Tools, model HT1181XL, with an extra-long barrel about 2 inches longer than typical irons. It reaches up to 430 degrees, with temperature set by a rheostat dial. It has a rotating cool tip and includes a heat-resistant mat to protect countertops.

specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: Large high-visibility orange impact gloves from Mad Grip. They feature seamless reinforcement in high-abrasion areas and grip injection technology for handling small and large parts. The breathable knit construction is machine washable.

specs.suspension: Front telescopic forks, rear mono shock

record.description: Blue 50cc two-stroke, air-cooled gas dirt bike for kids, with a pull start, fully automatic throttle, and chromoly steel frame. Features front telescopic forks, rear mono shock suspension, and disc brakes. Carries EPA and CE approvals.

Black battery case for iPhone 6, 6s, 7 and 8 (4.7-inch) with a 6000 mAh lithium-polymer battery. Charges the case and phone simultaneously and syncs data to a computer without removing the case. Charging starts and stops manually via a power button. Cable not included. Does not protect the screen or support wireless charging.

specs.material: Polycarbonate shell with clear TPU inner layer
specs.features: Raised bezel, enlarged cutouts for buttons and ports

record.description: Rose gold glitter protective case for the Apple iPhone XR (6.1 inch). This 3-in-1 hybrid design pairs a hard polycarbonate shell with a clear TPU inner layer for full front and back coverage. Features include a raised bezel around the screen and camera, and enlarged cutouts for buttons, ports, and the camera. Package contains one case.

specs.material: PU leather exterior with TPU base

record.description: Purple wallet-style flip case for the Samsung Galaxy S20 5G (6.2-inch). Made of PU leather over a TPU base, it has nine card slots, a zipper coin pocket, and two side pockets. It includes a detachable wrist strap, a foldable kickstand for hands-free viewing, and a magnetic flip closure.

specs.securing: Water tube tuck-under or reinforced tie-down loops

record.description: A black, 16 x 32 foot rectangular leaf net for swimming pools, made from durable knitted polyethylene. It is placed over a winter cover before leaves fall, keeping decaying leaves off the cover and out of the pool water. Secure it by tucking it under water tubes or using the reinforced tie-down loops.

Set of five blue polyurethane replacement casters for office chairs, with a 7/16 inch standard stem. Intended to roll quietly over cables and to suit hardwood, parquet, laminate, tile, and carpet, without a chair mat. Features ABEC9 bearings and is covered by a U.S. utility patent.

Refurbished Apple iPhone 8 (US version) with 64GB of storage in Space Gray. Locked to AT&T and not compatible with other carriers; check compatibility with your carrier before purchase. Battery health was tested, with a guaranteed minimum capacity of 80%. Includes a generic MFi-certified charger and cable. Headphones and SIM card are not included.

specs.size: One Size US (fits most teens and adults)

record.description: Forum Novelties women's oversized costume bonnet in white, with a floppy brim. One size fits most teens and adults. The bonnet is also offered in red and black. It is intended as a costume accessory for a classic, Americana-style look.

Men's Stance Chewbacca socks in green, size Large. Features a seamless toe closure, arch support, and reinforced heel and toe. The design is inspired by the Star Wars character Chewbacca.

record.description: Six 7 ml bottles of color-changing gel nail polish, packaged in a gift box. Set of three 5-ounce tall glass cups with double-wall insulation, intended for espresso, cappuccino, macchiato, and tea. The walls are meant to keep hot drinks warm and cold drinks cool. Suitable for cafés, restaurants, and home use, and works as a gift.

specs.bezel: 1mm raised edges around screen and camera

record.description: OUXUL protective case for the iPhone X and iPhone XS (5.8-inch) in Forest Green. Made of liquid silicone gel rubber, it covers all four edges and has a microfiber inner lining. specs.fits: 22 oz long neck bottle or tall beer bottle
specs.also fits: 16 to 20 oz water, soda, and sports drink bottles
specs.carry options: Shoulder strap or black plastic belt/backpack clip

record.description: Neoprene bottle sleeve with a drawstring top for water bottles and long-neck bottles. Includes a shoulder strap and a plastic clip for hanging on a belt or backpack.

specs.protection: Raised lips protect camera; full body coverage
